note: Round 2 of the FID loop (user, 2026-10-10): self-teaching with the model as its own judge (job cfg selfteach), 20-minute cycles, equal compute. Every run starts from the baseline checkpoint with base_change. A node trains base_steps / cost steps. change = patch of the job config. pass = next node if the FID beats the reference by more than the margin (the change is kept), fail = next node if not (the change is dropped). follower_only = runs only when another node names it. No node adds a model parameter.

st_z3.why: Self-teaching, z after block 3 (cheapest): crops of the output image and of the noised image are pulled to the clean crop in the model's own hidden state

st_z3_w2.why: Both self-teaching terms at weight 2, on top of the gain at weight 1

st_z3_out_only.why: Self-teaching at block 3 with the output term only (no noised pass, more steps), after both terms together failed

st_z8.why: Self-teaching, z after the last block (8), before the un-embed: the costliest judge

st_z8_out_only.why: Self-teaching at the last block with the output term only, after both terms together failed

st_z1.why: Self-teaching at block 1: the cheapest judge, so the most steps in the cycle

st_z6_out.why: Output term at block 6 in place of block 3: the winner of the Spark loop (116.08 against 122.52), compared with block 3 on this machine

st_out_w2.why: Output term of self-teaching at weight 2 in place of 1

st_out_half.why: Output term at weight 0.5, after weight 2 failed

st_z4_out.why: Output term at block 4: between block 3 (116.91) and block 6 (119.17 on this machine)

st_wide_crop.why: Wider range of crop sizes for the judge: 0.1 to 1.0 of the side in place of 0.2 to 0.9

st_whole_image.why: No crop: the judge compares the whole output image with the whole clean image. Does the crop matter at all?

st_judge_ema.why: The judge holds the averaged weights of the self-flow teacher in place of the weights of the last step: a steadier target

st_z3z6.why: Output term at blocks 3 and 6 together (mean of the two), one judge pass

st_no_selfflow_teacher.why: Is the self-flow teaching term still needed beside self-teaching? Teacher pass off (mixed noise stays), its compute goes to more steps

st_small_crop.why: Smaller crops for the judge: 0.1 to 0.5 of the side (116.23 against 116.08 on the Spark at block 6)

st_judge_t04.why: Judge at t = 0.4, after t = 0.7 gained

st_judge_t09.why: Judge at t = 0.9, a light noise, after t = 0.7 failed

st_flow_half.why: Self-flow teaching term at weight 0.5, after weight 2 failed
